rows.label: HAPS endurance hours
rows.envelope: Arithmetic only; station keeping needs wind, day/night energy and degradation proof.
rows.interpretation: 720 h endurance target before stratospheric energy-balance proof.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm solar resource, battery reserve, wind field, degradation, payload power and recovery plan.

rows.label: HAPS altitude conversion
rows.envelope: 49,000 to 82,000 ft is a broad HAPS operating band before airspace proof.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm operating altitude, airspace permissions, atmospheric density, thermal envelope and wind model.

rows.label: HAPS wingspan-to-altitude marker
rows.envelope: Marker only; aerodynamic feasibility needs wing area, mass, Reynolds number and aeroelastic proof.
rows.interpretation: 1.75 m/km is a trace marker, not an aerodynamic proof.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm wing area, mass budget, airfoil, aeroelastic margin, launch loads and transport constraints.
